membership_model: one continuous foreground probability per frozen Gaussian shared across every audited view
nvos_view_scope: the one official strict-unseen target view; source scribbles are not treated as a full mask
observation_operator: exact frozen front-to-back contribution divided by frozen total alpha

optimization.loss: uniform probability BCE plus 0.5 soft Dice

result_interpretation: The best constructed feasible membership is a lower bound on the unknown optimum. It diagnoses carrier/render capacity only and does not diagnose whether strict source evidence can recover that membership.
spin_view_scope: the single reference full mask plus every official evaluation mask, with one shared Gaussian membership
